name: verify_billing_admin
description: Verify whether an actor has the billing_admin role for a tenant.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: get_subscription
description: Retrieve subscription details for a tenant including plan, seat count, period dates, status, and pending scheduled changes.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: get_invoice_lines
description: Retrieve detailed line items and totals for an invoice. Only billing admins can view line-level breakdown.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: get_usage
description: Retrieve usage metrics (such as active seats) for a tenant.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: get_entitlements
description: Retrieve plan tier features, seat limits, and pricing details.

name: preview_plan_change
description: Preview the impact of changing plan or seats (cost delta, feature changes, effective date, seat compatibility) without modifying state.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: schedule_plan_change
description: Schedule a plan change for a tenant. The tenant's billing admin only, signed in to this conversation, after explicit confirmation. 'end_of_period' takes effect at current_period_end; 'immediate' applies an upgrade now (a downgrade is refused immediately). One pending change at a time: cancel it first. Idempotent via request_key: the same request returns the same change, a different request with that key is a conflict.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: cancel_scheduled_change
description: Cancel an existing pending scheduled plan change. Requires billing admin role.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: get_user_role
description: A user's name and role in the tenant (billing_admin or member). With no user_id, the caller's own role.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

user_id.description: The user to look up; defaults to the caller

name: list_tenant_users
description: The tenant's users with their roles and emails. Billing admins only.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: list_invoices
description: The tenant's invoices, newest first: id, period, subtotal, tax, total and status. Billing admins only.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: get_payment_status
description: The payment for one invoice: amount, status (succeeded, failed, retrying), card last four digits, failure reason and next retry. Billing admins only.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: get_credit_notes
description: Credit notes on the tenant's account (issued or pending review), optionally for one invoice. Billing admins only. The desk cannot issue credit notes.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

invoice_id.description: Only credit notes for this invoice

name: get_renewal_terms
description: The active subscription's term (monthly or annual), term end, auto-renewal, notice days, renewal price and whether a cancellation is scheduled. Billing admins only.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: schedule_cancellation
description: Schedule the active subscription to cancel at the end of its current term (cancel_at_period_end). The plan and entitlements stay until then. Immediate cancellation is refused. Billing admins only, after explicit confirmation; reuse the request_key on a retry.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: update_billing_contact
description: Change where the tenant's invoices go: the billing contact's name and email. Billing admins only, after reading the details back and getting confirmation.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: create_billing_case
description: Open a billing case for finance to decide: a refund, waiver, discount, dispute, payment problem or anything else the desk may not do. Any user of the tenant. Reuse the request_key on a retry.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

summary.description: What the customer asks and why

invoice_id.description: The invoice concerned, when there is one

name: get_billing_case_status
description: A billing case's category, invoice, status and resolution. Any user of the tenant.

actor_id.description: The user id of the person signed in to this conversation (a tenant user, e.g. U01_ADMIN, or a Cloudnest staff member). The desk acts only for that person; any other id is refused.

name: search_threads
description: Lists email threads matching a Gmail search query (label:ID, is:unread, in:inbox, from:, to:, subject:, newer_than:7d, free terms). Full message bodies are not returned; use get_thread for them. Drafts, spam and trash are excluded.

name: get_thread
description: Retrieves an email thread by ID with its messages in date order (bodies under FULL_CONTENT).

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: get_message
description: Retrieves one email message by its message ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: list_labels
description: Lists the user-defined labels of the mailbox with their IDs. System label IDs (INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, DRAFT, SPAM, TRASH) are usable without listing.

name: label_thread
description: Adds labels to an entire thread (every message in it). Takes label IDs, not names; use list_labels when unsure of a user label's ID.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: unlabel_thread
description: Removes labels from an entire thread. Takes label IDs, not names.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: list_drafts
description: Lists the mailbox's drafts, newest first. humanEdited marks a draft a person has edited.

name: create_draft
description: Creates a draft email for a person to review and send. To reply in an existing thread pass the original message's ID as replyToMessageId. Addresses are plain (no 'Name <email>'). Attachments are not supported yet. Nothing is sent.

replyToMessageId.description: The message this draft replies to; the draft joins its thread.

name: slack_search_channels
description: Search for Slack channels by name or topic. Returns channel IDs, names, topics, privacy and membership. Private channels appear only to their members.

keywords.description: Lexical terms that must appear in the channel's name or topic; single words or quoted phrases, all AND'd.

natural_language_query.description: The user's question in conversational tone.

name: slack_read_channel
description: Reads messages from a channel, newest first. Read-only. Use slack_read_thread with a message's ts to read its replies; use slack_search_channels to find a channel ID.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel to fetch history for.

name: slack_read_thread
description: Reads a thread: the parent message and its replies, oldest first. Read-only. message_ts is the parent message's ts.

message_ts.description: Timestamp of the parent message, e.g. "1234567890.123456".

name: slack_search_public_and_private
description: Searches messages in all channels the acting user can access. keywords are lexical terms (all AND'd); filters are Slack search modifiers: in:<#C123>, from:<@U123>, after:YYYY-MM-DD, before:YYYY-MM-DD. Give at least one of keywords or filters.

after.description: Only messages after this Unix timestamp.

before.description: Only messages before this Unix timestamp.

name: slack_send_message
description: Sends a message to a channel, or a thread reply with thread_ts. Posting is approval-gated: approval_id must name an approval of this exact destination and text for the acting user. request_key makes a retry return the message already posted instead of a duplicate. No @channel, @here or @everyone.

thread_ts.description: Parent message ts to reply in its thread.

name: slack_check_message_status
description: Check delivery status and idempotency ledger record for a given request_key.

request_key.description: The idempotency request key to inspect.
